baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 2-10 extracts from every shiyah whichever member is most intense in itiyy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each shiyah is a support-bound following. N-z-a forcefully separates an embedded member, while the comparative ranks the faction internally by hardened departure from obedience. The act exposes an extreme node rather than treating the faction as an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting a thing from its settled place supplies forceful separation of an embedded faction member.
Encompassing all parts makes the operation recur across every faction without remainder.
A supporting follower-group supplies the social unit whose internal maximum is selected.
Strength, hardness, and severity supply the comparative scale.
Haughty departure from obedience specifies what the comparison maximizes.

changed_reading.before: The worst people are selected from sects.
changed_reading.after: From every support-bound faction, its most hardened rebel is forcibly singled out, exposing an internal maximum rather than condemning a flat collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate at words 7-10 places intensified itiyy specifically against al-Rahman.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate overlays a tightened hardness onto active departure from obedience, with mercy and tenderness as its explicit counter-pole. The offense is relational: resistance hardens against mercy's claim rather than floating as generic misconduct.

activation_trace.role: Tightening a bond supplies the image of resistance made fast and difficult to loosen.
Tenderness, mercy, and beneficence specify the relation against which the resistance is directed.
Haughty departure from obedience keeps the hardening anchored in active refusal.

changed_reading.before: They are extremely disobedient toward God.
changed_reading.after: Their extremity is a self-fastened refusal directed specifically against mercy and beneficence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The superlative force of word 7 modifies the terminal-state potential of itiyy at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The terminal-state branch of itiyy, intensified by the hardness comparative, permits a temporal model: selection falls on the most calcified endpoint of rebellion, not merely the loudest current offender.

activation_trace.role: Hardness and severity supply degree to the terminal condition.
Old age and a terminal condition beyond repair supply calcification as an endpoint image, not a literal age claim.

changed_reading.before: The selection measures present intensity of rebellion.
changed_reading.after: The selection may measure rebellion that has matured into its most terminal and resistant state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding replacement generation follows desires repeatedly. This revises shiyah from a merely static party into a reproduced following-chain whose extreme member crystallizes and can transmit accumulated drift.

activation_trace.role: Following and accompanying supply the focus faction's chain of imitation.
Uprooting from a settled place breaks one member out of that transmitted formation.
One thing replacing another supplies the generational succession in which the formation is reproduced.
Following in another's track supplies the behavioral link that forms the chain.
Desire renewed after desire supplies the repeated motive that deepens the drift.

structural_cues: 19:59 places replacement, neglect, and following before 19:69's extraction from every faction; 19:60's exception prevents a deterministic ancestry reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, following, and repeated desire; I infer that affiliation can be reproduced by imitation. A live alternative is that shiyah denotes only synchronic parties.

changed_reading.before: A faction is a static membership container.
changed_reading.after: A faction can be a generational chain of imitation, and extraction exposes the member in whom its inherited drift has hardened most.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context names al-Rahman as promise-giver to servants and then commands worship. The focus opposition is therefore a refusal of a mercy-servanthood relation whose offered side has already been displayed.

activation_trace.role: A tightened bond supplies resistance made fast against the contextual relation.
Departure from obedience supplies the refusal side of that relation.
Mercy and beneficence identify the promise-giver before the same title becomes the focus counter-pole.
A promise that opens hope supplies the offered good against which refusal hardens.
Humble worship supplies the relational posture that focus itiyy rejects.

structural_cues: Al-Rahman recurs at 19:61 and 19:69, while servant language at 19:61 becomes an imperative to worship at 19:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, promise, servanthood, and worship; I read the focus preposition as relational resistance to that offer. Alternatively, the divine title may identify its referent without carrying the full contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse ranks generic defiance toward the deity.
changed_reading.after: It ranks a hardened repudiation of the merciful lord-servant relation already framed by promise and worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence first drives the whole company to a destination and forces it present, then extracts each faction's maximum, then assigns priority for contact with fire. Extraction functions as staged exposure and ordering rather than random seizure.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from place supplies the central selective movement after assembly.
The supporting group supplies the repeated compartments within the assembled whole.
Driving and gathering a group toward a destination supplies the mass assembly before extraction.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity place the gathered company at the selection site.
Priority and entitlement turn the extracted maximum into an ordered first claim.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the destination of that priority.

structural_cues: The repeated thumma sequence across 19:68, 19:69, and 19:70 orders gathering, extraction, and knowledgeable prioritization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered gathering, forced presence, extraction, and priority for fire; I infer a triage-like staging. Alternatively, extraction may only isolate cases for separate judgment without implying a queue.

changed_reading.before: The most rebellious are simply identified.
changed_reading.after: After total assembly, every faction yields its maximum into a visible priority order for exposure to fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: All successively arrive; then the protected are saved by separation while wrongdoers are left kneeling. This polarity makes the earlier extraction of the worst an exposure move distinct from the later rescue-extraction.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting supplies an ambiguous separation whose direction is clarified by the later polarity.
Advancing and entering in succession supplies the common arrival from which opposed separations operate.
Deliverance by separation reserves the rescue direction for the protected.
Placing oneself within protection identifies the class moved by rescue.
Leaving a thing in place supplies the opposite fate of the wrongdoers.
Kneeling fixes the left-behind class in the posture introduced before focus.

structural_cues: 19:71 universalizes arrival; 19:72's balanced verbs save one class and leave the other, with kneeling repeated from 19:68.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common arrival and an explicit rescue-versus-leave contrast; I infer that 19:69 foregrounds the worst rather than releasing them. A live alternative is that the two separations are independent acts with no paired choreography.

changed_reading.before: Being pulled out could sound like release from the gathered mass.
changed_reading.after: The worst are pulled forward for exposure; rescue is a later, oppositely directed separation reserved for the protected.

context_deltas.mechanism: A human boast ranks two parties by better station and assembly; the focus substitutes maximal rebellion as the diagnostic; the sequence then returns worse station and weaker host. The same comparative social field is reversed from public prestige to exposed resistance.

activation_trace.role: A mutually strengthening follower-group supplies the social formation whose prestige is remeasured.
Strength and hardness replace visible prestige as the comparison's hidden moral axis.
A separated faction or flock supplies the two-party unit in the challengers' boast.
Station and residence supply the first visible prestige metric.
The council where a group assembles supplies the second visible prestige metric.
Badness and harm reverse the earlier claim of being better.
The opposite of strength reverses the factions' implied social power.
A mutually supporting host returns factional solidarity as an exposed weakness.

structural_cues: The comparative arc runs from better station and better assembly in 19:73, through most intense rebellion in 19:69's governing scene, to worse station and weaker host in 19:75.
19:74 inserts past generations with superior goods and appearance, undercutting visible success as a stable measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored faction nouns, comparatives, station, assembly, and host; I infer that the focus comparison answers and reverses the boast. Alternatively, these may be adjacent but independent comparisons.

changed_reading.before: The divine selection uses an independent moral scale unrelated to factional self-presentation.
changed_reading.after: The selection exposes what factional prestige was measuring badly: the apparently better assembly can be the formation most hardened against mercy and headed toward worse standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Al-Rahman extends time for one in straying, while guidance is increased for the guided. These opposed trajectories strengthen a temporal reading of the focus maximum: itiyy can be an accrued, prolonged calcification rather than an innate fixed type.

activation_trace.role: A terminal condition beyond repair supplies the endpoint whose history context can now expose.
Hardness and severity supply the degree accumulated at that endpoint.
Deviation from guidance supplies the trajectory along which extension occurs.
A term or span made long supplies time in which the deviating state can persist.
Mercy is the named extender here and the explicit counter-pole of focus resistance.
Increase and growth supply the contrasting positive trajectory.
Gentle direction toward the right path specifies what grows on the opposite trajectory.

structural_cues: 19:75 repeats extension around the one in straying; 19:76 immediately answers with increase in guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prolonged straying and increased guidance; I infer that focus intensity can register an accrued endpoint. The text does not state that extension causes rebellion, and the comparative may rank only present conduct.

changed_reading.before: The terminal hardening model describes a fixed offender type.
changed_reading.after: The hardest offender may be the endpoint of a prolonged trajectory, contrasted with an equally dynamic growth in guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the undivided-property branch is remote from the ordinary group noun. It remains anchored in the focus shiyah and n-z-a branches and is activated by inheritance at 19:63; downstream prose should present it only as a legal-material analogy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of extraction at word 2, every at word 4, and shiyah at word 5 permits a partition image.

activation_trace.role: An undivided share in common property supplies the faction as a collectively held block.
Uprooting and removal supply the act that partitions one exposed share from the block.
Comprehensive totality makes the partitioning operation apply to each collective holding.
Property passing from predecessor to heir activates the nearby legal field of shares and partition.

changed_reading.before: Each faction simply yields one member.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal analogy, each faction resembles an undivided holding whose most resistant share is partitioned out, dissolving collective cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because shiyah ordinarily names a social faction, and the spark branch at 19:75 is especially form-remote. It remains valid as a material analogy through the focus fire-stoking branch and 19:70's explicit fire contact; prose should say the faction behaves like a stoking coalition, not translate it as fuel or assert literal causation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Shiyah at word 5 has a fire-stoking branch, while extraction and maximal intensity remain explicit at words 2 and 7.

activation_trace.role: Feeding wood to strengthen a fire supplies the faction as a coalition that intensifies a shared blaze.
Strength and severity supply the degree to which the collective blaze is intensified.
Uprooting supplies removal of the principal stoker from the coalition.
Meeting fire and its heat gives the material analogy a visible contextual destination.
Flying sparks provide a deliberately distant reinforcing echo for the stoked-fire image.

changed_reading.before: Factions are only containers from which severe members are selected.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, each faction is a stoking coalition whose fiercest intensifier is pulled forward to meet the fire.

strongest_changes: The verse became a staged intra-faction extraction inside a gather-present-prioritize sequence, not a free-standing statement about generic worst people.
The comparative reverses the factions' own better-station and better-assembly boast into a measure of rebellion followed by worse station and weaker host.
The later rescue-versus-leave polarity makes extraction of the worst an exposure move, while extended straying makes their hardness potentially accrued rather than fixed.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated a social topology: factions are support structures, imitation chains, and prestige assemblies whose collective cover is broken by individual extraction. The title al-Rahman made the ranked offense specifically anti-mercy.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not establish that the extracted maximum is a leader or causal representative rather than simply the most extreme member.
The extension in 19:75 may permit hardening without causing it; the temporal arrow remains reader-supplied.
The partition and fire-stoking models are analogies and must not displace the ordinary social sense of shiyah.
